title: Skysprawl
description: Adds a village in the sky
body:
A village that spawns in the sky. Has a focus on the vanilla aspects of the game. 

![Wooden walkways and platforms suspended by large hot air balloons of varying colors.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/19c9626f4d97d9158ce29f36f678e8a3a9ef04a9.jpeg)

## Current structures
### Houses:
- 3x small houses
- 1x double house
### Professions:
- Topographer (librarian and cartographer)
- Shepard
- Weapon/Toolsmith
- Cleric
- Farmers
- Butchers
- Fletcher

### Misc:
- Carrot, Potato, and Wheat Farms
- Anchor feature

## Management
Spawn:
/place structure skysprawl:sky_village

Locate:
/locate structure skysprawl:sky_village

### Note: This pack should work with Fabric 1.21.5 

Biomes for natural spawning:
- plains (will add more biomes and tags in the future)

Any future updates would add the rest of the professions and possibly add up and down sections for the street generation.
